I received payment from the Keepers.

The Aran tomb is now at peace once again.

script_text: Goodbye

text: I'm disappointed, but not surprised. I'm revoking your membership to the Dead Keepers. You are too irresponsible for this solemn work.
script_text:
;CK_LOST_URN
PCExpell, "Keepers of the Dead"
ModPCFacRep, -5, "Temple"
ModPCFacRep, -10, "Keepers of the Dead"
ModDisposition -30

text: You lost it. You lost a body. Are you serious?
script_text:
ModPCFacRep, -5, "Temple"
ModPCFacRep, -10, "Keepers of the Dead"
ModDisposition -30
;CK_LOST_URN

text: Was the internment successful?
script_text: Choice "I lost the remains." 1, "I'm still working on it." 2

text: If you weren't expelled, I'd talk with you about it.
script_text: ;individual quest completion responses go below here

text: Put simply, there's a large backlog of remains that must be interred in the ancestral tombs of Morrowind. The work is simple, but honest. I'll need to induct you into the Dead Keepers before you can be allowed to handle remains.
script_text: ;individual quest completion responses go below here

text:
Thank you for delivering the remains of Mehra Tharys.

There are still many more urns to inter. Your service is greatly appreciated.
script_text:
Journal "ck_balmora_tharys" 100
ModPCFacRep, 1, "Temple"
ModPCFacRep, 3, "Keepers of the Dead"
ModDisposition 10
player->AddItem "Gold_001" 100

text: You say the Heran tomb was desecrated by Daedra? How awful for the family. Thank you for clearing it out. Please, take these scrolls in case you run into any more trouble.
script_text:
Journal "ck_balmora_heran" 100
ModPCFacRep, 1, "Temple"
ModPCFacRep, 5, "Keepers of the Dead"
ModDisposition 10
player->AddItem "Gold_001" 400
player->AddItem "sc_almsiviintervention" 3

text: I'm glad to hear the Thalas tomb was in good repair, %PCName. Here is some gold for your trouble.
script_text:
Journal "ck_balmora_thalas" 100
ModPCFacRep, 1, "Temple"
ModPCFacRep, 3, "Keepers of the Dead"
ModDisposition 10
player->AddItem "Gold_001" 100

text:
Vampires in the Andrethi Tomb? And you've dispatched them all? You've done a great service today, %PCName.

I feel terrible for putting you in such danger. Vampirism is a terrible curse. Allow me to teach you a spell to cleanse your blood.
script_text:
Journal "ck_balmora_andrethi" 100
ModPCFacRep, 1, "Temple"
ModPCFacRep, 5, "Keepers of the Dead"
ModDisposition 10
player->AddItem "Gold_001" 400
player->AddSpell "cure common disease"

text:
Daedra again? I'm beginning to suspect that there is a pattern to these desecrations. Go the Ghostgate and notify the Keepers of the Dead there. I'm sure they will want to get involved.

Ah, I forget myself. The backlog is finished, thanks to you. Please, take these slippers. You've been so helpful.
script_text:
Journal "ck_balmora_saren" 100
ModPCFacRep, 1, "Temple"
ModPCFacRep, 5, "Keepers of the Dead"
ModDisposition 10
player->AddItem "Gold_001" 400
player->AddItem "ck_mule_slippers" 1

text: Here is the urn containing the remains. Take it to the Tharys Ancestral Tomb, which is just west of the Silt Strider port here in town. Don't just leave it in the hallway where people will trip on it. After interment, the family will want to visit.
script_text: Journal "ck_balmora_tharys" 10

text: Here is the urn containing the remains; bring it to the Heran Ancestral Tomb. You can find it south of Hla Oad.
script_text: Journal "ck_balmora_heran" 10

text: Here is the urn containing the remains of Drarym Thalas.
script_text: Journal "ck_balmora_thalas" 10

text: Here is the urn containing the remains of Bylen Andrethi. Do be careful.
script_text: Journal "ck_balmora_andrethi" 10

text: Here is the urn containing the remains of Felara Saren.
script_text: Journal "ck_balmora_saren" 10

text: I can't trust you with any interments. You've been expelled from the Keepers of the Dead.
script_text: ;new delivery offers go below this line

text: Would you deliver this ceremonial urn containing the remains of Mehra Tharys in the Tharys Ancestral Tomb? It's quite heavy.
script_text: Choice "I'm ready." 1, "Later." 2

text: The Heran Ancestral Tomb hasn't been checked on in a long time. Inter the remains of Joveth Heran there, and ensure the tomb itself has been properly secured.
script_text: Choice "I'm ready." 1, "Later." 2

text: Your next interment is in Thalas Ancestral Tomb. Follow the foyada near Fort Moonmoth north, then take a right at Assarnatamat.
script_text: Choice "I'm ready." 1, "Later." 2

text: Put to rest the remains of Bylen Andrethi at the Andrethi Ancestral Tomb. It's west of Balmora and south of the Norvayn Ancestral Tomb, which I've sent you to before.
script_text: Choice "I'm ready." 1, "Later." 2

text:
This will be your last interment from me, %PCName. It's hard to believe that we're nearly finished.

Please deliver Felara Saren to the Saren Ancestral Tomb. To get there, take the bridge near Fort Moonmoth that spans the foyada. Once on the other side, travel northeast.
script_text: Choice "I'm ready." 1, "Later." 2

text: I don't have any more pending interments.
script_text: Choice "I'm ready." 1, "Later." 2

text: I don't have any more pending internments. You've cleared out the entire backlog. I would be happy to write you a letter of recommendation for advancement in the Keepers of the Dead.
script_text: Choice "I'm ready." 1, "Later." 2

text: If you had better standing with the Temple, I'd talk with you about it.
